description: This file declares a Java interface 'ConnectivityCommandInterceptor' that serves as a hook for intercepting and validating connectivity commands within the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides methods to process commands, retrieve associated connections, and supports default behavior for connection extraction based on command type.

classes.name: ConnectivityCommandInterceptor
classes.description: A functional interface for intercepting connectivity commands, allowing validation or modification, with default methods for connection retrieval.

methods.name: getConnectionFromCommand
methods.description: Retrieves the Connection object associated with a given ConnectivityCommand based on its type.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Default implementation of the Consumer interface; processes a command and optionally retrieves its associated connection.
